research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Claroty is researching methods for automated detection and alert of misconfigured industrial automation devices, focusing on operational technology networks with programmable logic controllers and distributed control systems. Additionally, they are developing network discovery and maintenance techniques for industrial plants, including identifying hosts and managing industrial engineering devices. These efforts address both device configuration and network management in industrial cybersecurity.

overview_description.description: Claroty is a cybersecurity company that develops a platform to secure cyber-physical systems and connected operational technology across industrial, healthcare, commercial, and public sector environments. Its platform offers capabilities for asset inventory, exposure and risk management, network protection, secure access controls, and continuous threat detection to help organizations identify and prioritize vulnerabilities and anomalous activity. Claroty products are designed for deployment both in the cloud through its xDome offering and on-premises with solutions like continuous monitoring tools. It integrates with existing security infrastructure and provides contextualized visibility into devices and network behavior to support risk reduction and operational continuity.

about_short_description.short_description: Claroty is a cybersecurity company that protects XIoT and cyber-physical systems from cyber threats.

product.name: Claroty Platform
product.description: A cyber-physical systems security platform for discovering, assessing, protecting, and monitoring XIoT assets across industrial, healthcare, commercial, and public-sector environments.

product.name: Claroty xDome
product.description: A SaaS-based CPS protection platform that provides XIoT asset visibility, risk and exposure management, network protection, threat detection, and operational security workflows.

product.name: Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD)
product.description: A solution for continuously monitoring OT, IoT, and other CPS network activity to identify threats, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and suspicious communications.

product.name: Claroty xDome Secure Access
product.description: A secure remote-access solution for internal and third-party users connecting to industrial, healthcare, commercial, and public-sector cyber-physical systems.

product.name: Claroty Edge
product.description: A discovery solution that provides rapid visibility into industrial and other CPS environments, including assets that may be unreachable through conventional monitoring.

product.name: Claroty Claire
product.description: A CPS-native AI security agent that uses Claroty’s CPS data and security context to prioritize risks, investigate alerts, generate remediation actions, and automate reporting.
